non_obvious_findings: The UX audit's former missing Page Thread Bridge condition is stale: later durable bridge candidate evidence exists, so the frontier moved from bridge creation to causal wiring and local reconciliation.

Wire page-scoped correction identity through claim/run/RETURN lineage and derive concise execution-state/result projection into the same thread/feed.

A candidate path name overrides explicit SERVED_MANIFEST digest authority -> FAIL.
A correction is shown complete without a durable RETURN -> FAIL.
Two equivalent corrections create two independent authority-bearing actions -> FAIL.
Private human literal is emitted into public coordination artifacts -> FAIL.
Bridge/steward unit tests are presented as browser/device Human Acceptance -> FAIL.
Current/Human Accepted/Served is promoted by local planner or steward -> FAIL.
Registry mismatch is silently flattened by newest-wins -> FAIL.
